meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 deepTools 命令行处理测序数据：把 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖度轨迹、跑质控（相关性、PCA、指纹图），并在 TSS 或峰区画热图和曲线图。
howto.when: 当你要把 BAM 转成 bigWig、检查 ChIP 质量，或在 TSS／峰区画热图时触发。

say.text: 把 input.bam 转成 bigWig，用 RPGC 归一化
say.note: 会运行 bamCoverage 生成覆盖度轨迹

say.text: 检查这批 ChIP-seq 数据质量，做相关性和指纹图
say.note: 会生成相关性热图和指纹图

say.text: 在 TSS 附近画 ChIP 信号热图和曲线图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs deepTools commands on sequencing data: converts BAM to bigWig coverage tracks, runs QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and draws heatmaps/profiles at TSS or peaks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you convert BAM to bigWig, check ChIP quality, or plot heatmaps around TSS or peaks.

say_en.text: Convert input.bam to bigWig with RPGC normalization
say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage to make a coverage track

say_en.text: Check this ChIP-seq data's quality with correlation and fingerprint plots
say_en.note: Produces a correlation heatmap and fingerprint plot

say_en.text: Plot ChIP signal heatmap and profile around TSS
say_en.note: Computes the signal matrix first, then plots
